title: Set up SSO & access management
summary: Set up Okta/Google SSO across all company tools with role-based access, MFA, and provisioning.

parts.title: Set up your identity provider tenant
parts.guidance: Verify company control of the domain and choose the identity tenant for the intended applications. Review licensing, administrator ownership and account recovery before creating the approved account and granting privileged access. Establish protected recovery access before changing production sign-in. Record the tenant identifier so later integrations connect to the correct company environment.

parts.title: Define role-based groups
parts.guidance: Map actual job responsibilities to required application access. Define separate ordinary, privileged, contractor and service-identity groups where appropriate, with membership criteria and responsible managers. Check overlapping grants and exceptions before creating approved groups. The resulting role-to-access mapping should support onboarding, role changes and departure without giving every user every application.

parts.title: Configure SSO for each app
parts.guidance: Follow each application’s supported federation setup for the correct tenant, claims and user-matching rules. Keep a recovery route while testing the integration with designated accounts. Apply production sign-in changes through the established access-change process. Verify the resulting identity and access level, then record working settings and provider-documented certificate or secret rotation needs.

parts.title: Enable MFA policies
parts.guidance: Choose supported authentication methods based on account risk and plan enrollment, lost-device recovery and emergency access. Pilot the policy with representative users and privileged accounts before approving enforcement and exceptions through the company’s access-control process. Resolve enrollment failures and test the supported recovery route before rollout.

parts.title: Provision existing users
parts.guidance: Match the current employee and contractor roster to existing application identities. Resolve duplicate or shared accounts and verify each person’s approved groups and licenses. With the relevant access approvals, pilot provisioning on a small population before expanding. Investigate missing users and unexpected privileges before expanding provisioning.

parts.title: Test SSO across all apps
parts.guidance: Test sign-in, sign-out, recovery, role changes and deprovisioning using representative ordinary, privileged and unauthorized accounts. Verify denial as carefully as successful login. Record failures by application and fix blocking issues before rollout, with any remaining exception decided by the accountable owner. Recovery should work without bypassing the intended access policy.

parts.title: Roll out to team
parts.guidance: Give staff the new sign-in instructions, enrollment steps and support route. Coordinate rollout timing and approved enforcement through the existing access-change process. Watch for failed logins and access mismatches, using the agreed rollback if needed. Resolve pending users and application exceptions, then hand tenant and group maintenance to the team handling onboarding, transfers and departures.

metadata.supportReason: Okta API supports user/app management. Individual app SSO configuration varies in automation support.
